verdict.rationale: Devin ships a documented public API (docs-7) with session creation, org-level features like create_as_user_id (docs-8), plus a CLI and MCP server for programmatic/agentic control (docs-4, docs-6, probe-4, probe-5), directly enabling AI-native users to drive it programmatically.
